evidence.why: Frozen setup and downstream selector-dependent behavior.

facts.rationale: Corrects the prior description of ftCo_80090AC0 as cleanup: its canonical body spawns effect 0x415 and marks the effect active.
facts.value: Initializes the frozen Star KO variant: sets x2227_b6, performs shared death cleanup, initializes the common-data countdown and phase zero, enters ftCo_MS_DeadUpStarIce, applies shared death setup, requests fighter sound and player notification, creates the scaled DamageIce effect, requests rumble event 1, and sets x68 to 1. The shared Star animation callback uses that selector for phase-1 rotation and later effect cleanup.

evidence.why: Distinct accessory callback and conditional coin helper.

facts.rationale: Preserves exact transition flags, exceptional motion choices and the external callback handoff while correcting the subsystem label.
facts.value: At DeadUpFall phase-1 expiry, the caller chooses motion 10 for the frozen selector, motion 8 for non-unit Z scale, or motion 7 otherwise. This helper enters the supplied motion with Ft_MF_SkipRumble | Ft_MF_SkipColAnim, sets death/presentation flags, applies the fixed root rotation only at unit Z scale, requests fighter-wide feedback, quake and sound, invokes conditional coin processing, and installs fn_800D4DD4 as accessory4_cb. The caller then loads the next timer and advances to phase 2. ColAnim denotes color-animation handling, not collision animation.

evidence.why: Terminal motion change, inactivity and associated-entity handling.

facts.rationale: Corrects the claimed repeated terminal invocation and distinguishes disappearance from the later Sleep/inactivity transition.
facts.value: Runs phases 0–4 using x44 and countdown x40. A nonzero countdown is decremented once per invocation; phase transitions occur at zero. Phase-0 expiry initializes interpolation progress and enters phase 1. Phase 1 advances progress, optionally rotates the frozen fighter, and on expiry selects impact motion 10, 8 or 7 according to frozen selector and Z scale before entering phase 2. Phase-2 expiry installs configured Y/Z velocities and enters phase 3. Phase-3 expiry resets movement, conditionally clears frozen effects, sets x221F_b1 and invisibility, performs death accounting and audiovisual feedback, and enters phase 4 with the final delay. Phase-4 expiry invokes ftCo_800BFD9C, which changes motion to Sleep and sets inactivity flags; repeated finalization is not the normal callback lifetime.
